working_definition: Olfactory projection neuron type DC3 (Li et al. 2017) at 24 h or 36 h APF.
searches_performed: immature antennal lobe projection neuron DC3

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any antennal lobe projection neuron (FBbt:00007422) that develops from some neuroblast BAmv3 (FBbt:00067346).

justification: Up to the pupal stage the immature term is used (curator), but FBbt has no immature (or remodelling) antennal lobe projection neuron terms yet (requested, curator 2026-10-17); meanwhile the stage-neutral class for the authors' lineage (adPN), to be refined when the new terms exist. Lineage from the paper's definitions: DA1 and DL3 PNs are acj6- lPNs (Mz19+/acj6- DA1; the acj6-/CG31676+ clusters #6 / #6' DL3), VA1d, DC3, DC2 and VM2 acj6+ adPNs (Figures 3-4).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00067349 antennal lobe projection neuron adPN (broad match) until FBbt has the immature / remodelling term for DC3.
